releases.notes:
First public release of Sealed Client — a Fabric utility client for Minecraft
Java Edition, written from scratch.

> **Read this first.** This includes features that break the rules on most
> servers. What is allowed varies by server and changes without notice. If you
> get banned, that is on you.

## Install

1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API for your Minecraft version.
2. Put **one** jar in your `mods` folder:

| Minecraft | Java | File |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.21.4 | 21 | `sealed-client-mc1.21.4-1.0.0.jar` |
| 26.2 | 25 | `sealed-client-mc26.2-1.0.0.jar` |

3. Launch the game and press `P`.

Do not install both jars.

All 90 features work on both versions. Everything risky ships **turned off** —
you enable what you want. If something goes wrong, `;sealed panic` turns
combat, movement, and automation off and releases any key or slot being held.

## Verifying your download

```shell
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS
```

`SHA256SUMS` covers every file here. It only means something if you get the
hash through a path you trust independently of the jar — if both come from the
same untrusted mirror, both can be replaced.

An SBOM for each platform lists the runtime dependencies and their hashes. It
is an audit record, not a vulnerability scan.

## Where it stands

- **No outbound connections.** No HTTP, sockets, webhooks, or remote updates
- **No account access.** Launcher accounts, profiles, and auth tokens are never
  read
- **No external processes, no downloaded code**
- A source scan checks all of the above on every build
- Dependencies are checksum-pinned

None of this proves there is no malicious code. Reading the source and building
it yourself is the strongest check available to you — see
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Ketchio-dev/sealed-client/blob/v1.0.0/SECURITY.md).

## Measured, not claimed

Rather than asserting this is fast or accurate, each property has a ceiling
that cannot be beaten, measured against a real dedicated server:

| | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reaction latency | **1 tick** (12/12 samples) |
| Crystal placement | **matches exhaustive search** (2000 trials) |
| Explosion damage prediction | **7 of 10 exact**, worst case 0.5 high |

Prediction error is one-directional: never lower than the damage actually
dealt. These are not benchmarks against other clients — there is no competitor
in the measurement, only distance from a theoretical ceiling.

## Known scope

1.21.4 and 26.2 only. Other versions are not "coming soon" — the remaining work
is [written down as a number](https://github.com/Ketchio-dev/sealed-client/blob/v1.0.0/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#what-another-minecraft-version-costs).

Baritone pathfinding needs the official Baritone installed separately. It is
not bundled and nothing is downloaded automatically.
